name: specstream
description: Teams and agents get the finished list (companies, people, products and more) from the live web, every row with its source, priced per result. Ask in plain words from Cursor and approve the price before anything runs.

SPECSTREAM_API_KEY.title: SpecStream API key
SPECSTREAM_API_KEY.description: Create one under Agents & API in your SpecStream workspace. Keep it in this setting, never in a prompt or a commit. Paid work still needs your approval of the price.
